name: GHL Contacts Manager
author: The One Technologies

sections.description:
GHL Contacts Manager is a powerful WordPress plugin that provides seamless integration with GoHighLevel CRM, enabling you to manage contacts, opportunities, and business pipelines directly from your WordPress admin panel.

Key Features

  • Contact Management: View, create, and manage all your GoHighLevel contacts
  • Opportunity Pipeline: Visual Kanban board for managing sales opportunities
  • Drag & Drop Interface: Move opportunities between pipeline stages with ease
  • Task Management: Create and assign tasks to contacts and team members
  • Appointment Scheduling: Schedule appointments with integrated calendar support
  • Real-time Sync: Automatic synchronization with your GoHighLevel account
  • Professional UI: Modern, responsive interface designed for business use

What You Can Do

  • Import and manage all your GoHighLevel contacts
  • View contact details, tags, appointments, and opportunities
  • Create new contacts directly from WordPress
  • Manage sales pipelines with visual Kanban boards
  • Drag and drop opportunities between stages
  • Create tasks and assign them to team members
  • Schedule appointments with calendar integration
  • Search and filter contacts and opportunities
  • Export contact data and reports

Perfect For

  • Sales teams managing leads and opportunities
  • Businesses using GoHighLevel for CRM
  • Agencies managing multiple client pipelines
  • Entrepreneurs tracking business growth
  • Teams needing centralized contact management

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • GoHighLevel account with API access
  • Valid GoHighLevel API key and Location ID

Getting Started

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Go to the GHL Contacts Manager menu in your WordPress admin sidebar
  3. Click Settings to configure your GoHighLevel API key and Location ID
  4. Start managing your contacts and opportunities!

Support

For support, documentation, and updates, visit our official website.

External Services

This plugin connects to the GoHighLevel API to provide CRM functionality. The following data is sent to GoHighLevel:

Contact Data: When creating or updating contacts, the plugin sends contact information including name, email, phone, company, address, and tags to GoHighLevel’s servers.

Opportunity Data: When managing sales opportunities, opportunity details including title, value, stage, and assigned contact are sent to GoHighLevel.

Task Data: When creating tasks, task information including title, description, due date, and assigned user is sent to GoHighLevel.

Appointment Data: When scheduling appointments, appointment details including title, description, start/end times, and contact information are sent to GoHighLevel.

API Authentication: Your GoHighLevel API key and Location ID are used to authenticate API requests. These credentials are stored securely in WordPress options and transmitted only to GoHighLevel’s secure API endpoints.

This service is provided by GoHighLevel: Terms of Service, Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ghl-contacts-manager directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Use the GHL Contacts Manager menu to access plugin features
  4. Click Settings to enter your GoHighLevel API key and Location ID
  5. Start managing your contacts and opportunities!
sections.faq:
How do I get my GoHighLevel API key?

You can find your API key in your GoHighLevel account under Settings > API Keys. If you don’t have one, contact GoHighLevel support.

What is a Location ID?

The Location ID is your specific GoHighLevel location identifier. You can find this in your GoHighLevel account settings or by contacting GoHighLevel support.

Can I use this with multiple GoHighLevel accounts?

Currently, the plugin supports one GoHighLevel account per WordPress installation. For multiple accounts, you would need separate WordPress installations.

Is my data secure?

Yes, all API communications are encrypted using HTTPS, and your API credentials are stored securely in WordPress options.

Can I export my data?

Yes, you can export contact data and opportunity information through the plugin interface.

Does this work with WooCommerce?

This plugin is designed for general contact and opportunity management. For WooCommerce integration, you may want to look for a dedicated WooCommerce-GoHighLevel integration plugin.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Compliance Fix: Addressed all feedback from the WordPress.org plugin review team.
  • Security: Hardened security by adding ABSPATH checks to all PHP files to prevent direct access.
  • Security: Improved data sanitization for all nonce verifications to enhance security.
  • Prefixing: Replaced all generic prefixes (ghl_, totghl_) with the unique ghlcoma_ prefix to prevent conflicts.
  • Code Quality: Refactored settings page to properly enqueue CSS and JS files instead of using inline styles and scripts.
  • Bugfix: Resolved unescaped output errors reported by the Plugin Check utility.

1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • Contact management functionality
  • Opportunity pipeline with Kanban board
  • Task creation and management
  • Appointment scheduling
  • GoHighLevel API integration
  • Professional admin interface
  • Modernized settings page UI with card layout, status badge, and disconnect button
  • Updated admin menu structure: GHL Contacts Manager > Settings, View Contacts, View Opportunities
